title: NDA — company playbook (Poland)
status: draft — example rules, must be validated by a Polish lawyer (radca prawny)
our_side: Disclosing and receiving party (mutual NDA preferred)

rules.red_flag: Foreign law (e.g. English, German, US state law).
rules.suggested_edit: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Poland.

rules.standard: Common court competent for our registered seat in Poland.
rules.suggested_edit: Any disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved by the common court competent for the registered seat of [Our Company].

rules.red_flag: Perpetual / indefinite obligation, or more than 10 years.
rules.suggested_edit: The obligations of confidentiality shall survive for a period of three (3) years following the termination or expiry of this Agreement.

rules.standard: At least: public domain, already known, independently developed, lawfully received from a third party.
rules.suggested_edit: Confidential Information shall not include information which: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to the Receiving Party before disclosure; (c) is independently developed by the Receiving Party; or (d) is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality.

rules.standard: Disclosure allowed if required by law or a competent authority, with prior notice where lawful.
rules.suggested_edit: The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law or by a decision of a competent court or authority, provided that it notifies the Disclosing Party in advance where legally permitted.

rules.standard: None, or mutual and not higher than PLN 100,000 per breach.
rules.red_flag: One-sided penalty or more than PLN 100,000 per breach.
rules.suggested_edit: In the event of a breach of this Agreement, the breaching Party shall pay the other Party a contractual penalty of PLN 50,000 per breach. The aggrieved Party may claim damages exceeding the contractual penalty.

rules.standard: Liability under general rules of the Polish Civil Code; no indemnities.
rules.red_flag: Unlimited liability, indemnification for all losses, or liability for indirect losses.
rules.suggested_edit: Each Party shall be liable for breach of this Agreement in accordance with the Polish Civil Code. Neither Party shall be liable for lost profits or indirect losses.

rules.red_flag: Non-solicitation of employees or non-compete hidden in the NDA.
rules.suggested_edit: Delete the clause. Non-solicitation, if needed, belongs in the main commercial agreement.

rules.standard: Return or destroy on request or at termination; archival copies allowed if required by law.
rules.suggested_edit: Upon the Disclosing Party's written request or termination of this Agreement, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information, except copies it is required to retain by law.

rules.standard: Clause on personal data under Regulation (EU) 2016/679, or a statement that no personal data is shared.
rules.red_flag: Missing when personal data may be exchanged.
rules.suggested_edit: If Confidential Information includes personal data, the Parties shall process it in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and, where required, conclude a data processing agreement.
